about.text: Indian yoghurt strained in muslin until it is thick and semi-solid. Sweetened and spiced with cardamom and saffron, it becomes shrikhand.

facts.v: Afghan chaka or chakida is a thick sour dairy topping on dishes; sources differ on whether it is sour cream or strained yoghurt
Meiji calls it thickened doogh, made thick by draining the whey through a cloth sack

sources.text: Its names and facts, from these.
